about.title: About Us
about.p1: VIVIDPOLY serves global import buyers with professional communication, clear product specifications, custom packaging options, and responsive export support. Capacity, construction, printing, and packing are tailored to your product and destination market so every order matches your filling process, branding need, and shipping condition.
about.p2: Request samples before committing to full quantities. Bale, pallet, and carton packing are planned for safe international shipment across ten woven PP constructions, from open mouth to premium laminated formats, matched to rice, fertilizer, cement, feed, and retail uses.
about.exportVisionBody: VIVIDPOLY aims to become a trusted Indian export partner for global businesses that require strong, customizable, and brand-ready PP bags. We understand that international buyers need more than general product descriptions. They need accurate specifications, product-use guidance, artwork and printing support, suitable packing options, and responsive communication throughout the enquiry process.

faqList.q: What types of PP bags does VIVIDPOLY export?
faqList.a: VIVIDPOLY exports open mouth bags, top and bottom stitched bags, D-cut PP woven bags, valve bags, carry bags, printed and laminated woven PP bags, printed and laminated woven PP pinch bottom bags, printed and laminated woven PP block bottom bags, printed and laminated woven PP block bottom gusset bags, and woven shopping bags.

faqList.q: What weight capacity is available for VIVIDPOLY PP bags?
faqList.a: VIVIDPOLY can discuss PP bag requirements from 5 kg to 75 kg, depending on product density, bag size, fabric strength, construction, lamination, liner, gusset, stitching, and end-use application.

faqList.q: What information is needed for a quotation?
faqList.a: Buyers should provide product type, packed product, capacity, bag size, quantity, printing requirement, lamination, liner, gusset, handle, cutting, stitching, packing type, destination country, and artwork or sample reference if available.

faqList.q: Can VIVIDPOLY supply printed and laminated woven PP bags?
faqList.a: Yes. VIVIDPOLY can support printed and laminated woven PP bag requirements for products such as rice, flour, fertilizer, animal feed, pet food, seeds, salt, sugar, and retail commodities.

faqList.q: What is the difference between open mouth bags and valve bags?
faqList.a: Open mouth bags are filled through an open top and closed after filling. Valve bags are filled through a valve opening and are commonly used for powders, cement-style products, chemicals, minerals, and construction materials.

faqList.q: What are pinch bottom bags used for?
faqList.a: Pinch bottom bags are used where buyers need premium packaging appearance and clean closure presentation. They are suitable for selected food, pet food, animal feed, grains, seeds, and retail products.

faqList.q: What are block bottom gusset bags used for?
faqList.a: Block bottom gusset bags are suitable where buyers need improved volume, stable filled shape, stronger branding area, and better stacking presentation.
Yes. Selected printed and laminated woven PP bags can include a transparent window to show the packed product inside.

faqList.q: Can VIVIDPOLY provide liners inside PP bags?
faqList.a: Yes. Liners can be considered where additional product protection, moisture support, or fine product retention is required.
VIVIDPOLY can support plain bags, flexo printed bags, and printed and laminated woven PP bag formats, depending on branding needs, artwork complexity, budget, and product market.
